title: How Long, O Lord?

questions.question: O God, the nations have come into your inheritance; they have defiled your holy what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 79:1 (ESV): "...they have defiled your holy temple;"

questions.question: They have laid Jerusalem in what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 79:1 (ESV): "they have laid Jerusalem in ruins."

questions.question: They have given the bodies of your servants to the birds of the heavens for what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 79:2 (ESV): "They have given the bodies of your servants to the birds of the heavens for food,"

questions.question: They have poured out their blood like water all around where?
questions.explanation: Psalm 79:3 (ESV): "They have poured out their blood like water all around Jerusalem,"

questions.question: We have become a taunt to our neighbors, mocked and derided by those around whom?
questions.explanation: Psalm 79:4 (ESV): "We have become a taunt to our neighbors, mocked and derided by those around us."

questions.question: How long, O Lord? Will you be angry forever? Will your jealousy burn like what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 79:5 (ESV): "Will your jealousy burn like fire?"

questions.question: Pour out your anger on the nations that do not know whom?
questions.explanation: Psalm 79:6 (ESV): "Pour out your anger on the nations that do not know you,"

questions.question: For they have devoured Jacob and laid waste his what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 79:7 (ESV): "For they have devoured Jacob and laid waste his habitation."

questions.question: Do not remember against us our former iniquities; let your compassion come speedily to meet us, for we are brought very what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 79:8 (ESV): "...for we are brought very low."

questions.question: Help us, O God of our salvation, for the glory of your name; deliver us, and atone for our sins, for your name's what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 79:9 (ESV): "...deliver us, and atone for our sins, for your name's sake!"

questions.question: Why should the nations say, "Where is their what?"
questions.explanation: Psalm 79:10 (ESV): "Why should the nations say, 'Where is their God?'"

questions.question: Let the avenging of the outpoured blood of your servants be known among the nations before our what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 79:10 (ESV): "...unknown among the nations before our eyes!"

questions.question: Let the groans of the prisoners come before you; according to your great power, preserve those doomed to what?
Return sevenfold into the lap of our neighbors the taunts with which they have taunted you, O what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 79:12 (ESV): "...the taunts with which they have taunted you, O Lord!"

questions.question: But we your people, the sheep of your pasture, will give thanks to you when?
questions.explanation: Psalm 79:13 (ESV): "...will give thanks to you forever;"

key_verse_text: Help us, O God of our salvation, for the glory of your name; deliver us, and atone for our sins, for your name's sake!
